query: Current fill percentage/storage of Lázaro Cárdenas (El Palmito) dam in Durango Mexico from Conagua SINA, latest daily readings for July 2026 and late June 2026
answer:
Research complete. Here's a summary of the key findings on the **Lázaro Cárdenas ("El Palmito") dam** in Durango:

## Latest Readings (July 2026)
- **~July 16, 2026: ~19% of NAMO / ~598 Mm³** (most recent confirmed reading)
- **July 8, 2026: 21%** per Conagua hydrometric report
- **July 17, 2026:** Still ~19% ("falling"), despite +25 Mm³ inflow in 24h

## Late June 2026
- **June 19–20, 2026: 25.87% / 765 Mm³** (declining ~7 Mm³/day)
- **June 1, 2026: 31.0% / 915.948 Mm³**

## Key Context
- **Total capacity (NAMO): ~2,957.61 Mm³**
- **Clear declining trend:** dropped ~12 percentage points (~318 Mm³) from June 1 to mid-July 2026, as extractions (~109 m³/s) for the 2026 agricultural cycle (750 Mm³ committed) outpaced weak rainfall inflows from the upper Nazas basin.
- Historically low state; operators projected gate closure in the last week of July 2026, ending near ~565 Mm³.

## Sourcing Notes
The official Conagua **SINA portal** (`sinav30.conagua.gob.mx:8080/Presas/`) requires JavaScript and couldn't be scraped directly, so all figures come from Mexican press outlets citing the **daily Conagua/CNA hydrometric reports** (Milenio, El Sol de la Laguna/OEM, Vanguardia, El Coahuilense, POSTA, Meganoticias). I carefully separated 2026 data from similar-looking 2024/2025 drought-era readings.

Full structured findings (key facts, data points, and sources) have been submitted via the StructuredOutput tool.
